bbs_together.config.title: BBS Together
bbs_together.utility.sync.title: BBS Together Sync
bbs_together.config.cdn.title: Asset Sync
bbs_together.config.cdn.tooltip: BBS Together asset sync and CDN configuration
bbs_together.config.cdn.url-comment: CDN server address for asset synchronization.
bbs_together.config.cdn.token-comment: Token required to access the CDN server.
bbs_together.config.cdn.download-comment: When enabled, missing assets will be downloaded from the server.
bbs_together.config.cdn.upload-comment: When enabled, local assets will be uploaded to the server.
bbs_together.config.cdn.receive-comment: When enabled, receive asset updates pushed by the server.
bbs_together.config.cdn.progress_bar-com: Show a thin progress bar above the task bar while assets are syncing.
bbs_together.config.cdn.progress_bar_alw: Keep the progress bar visible after sync completes instead of fading it out.
bbs_together.config.server.title: Sync Settings
bbs_together.config.server.tooltip: Each player configures their own client-side download size ceiling.
bbs_together.config.server.asset_max_siz: Maximum total size of a model/asset folder this client will download, between 16 MB and 2 GB (preset steps: 16 / 128 / 512 MB / 1 GB / 2 GB). Models larger than this are not fully downloaded — only the folder and config.json are created as a placeholder, and they show up red as "模型过大" in the model picker. Uploads are not limited by this setting.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.tooltip: Default keyframe style for new keyframes created through BBS Together
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_co: Color assigned to newly created keyframes when color override is enabled.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.title: Keyframes
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_co: When enabled, newly created keyframes get the color below instead of using the track color.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_in: When enabled, newly created keyframes use the selected interpolation below. When disabled, BBSFS keeps its original track or previous-keyframe interpolation behavior.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_sh: Default shape for newly created keyframes. Click the icon on the right to choose a shape.
bbs_together.config.keyframes.default_in: When default keyframe interpolation is enabled, newly created keyframes use the interpolation selected here.
bbs_together.config.behaviors.title: Behavior log
bbs_together.config.behaviors.tooltip: Server-side audit log of edits, downloads and uploads
bbs_together.config.behaviors.behavior_l: Maximum number of behavior entries kept on the server (100-50000). The oldest entries are evicted first. Edit config/bbs/settings/bbs_together.json on dedicated servers and restart.
bbs_together.behaviors.title: Server behaviors
bbs_together.behaviors.desc.edit_model_b: Picked model %s for a model block
bbs_together.behaviors.details.empty: Pick a behavior to see its details
